title: Pilot Replanning
prompt: Replan the pilot timeline and responsibilities given the current memory state.
prompt_zh: 请根据当前记忆状态重排 pilot 的时间线和责任分工。

title: Execution Risks
prompt: List the main blockers, risks, and unresolved issues affecting pilot launch and recruitment.
prompt_zh: 请列出当前影响 pilot 启动和招募推进的关键阻塞项、风险和待决问题。

title: Decision Audit
prompt: Judge whether it is consistent with the meeting to start recruitment now and run the pilot next week.
prompt_zh: 请判断“现在开始招募并在下周启动 pilot”是否与会议结论一致。
